name: @openclaw/learning-loop-reporter
description: Feishu channel adapter for self-learning-loop daily report markdown

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='dist/cli.js';const c=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');if(!c.startsWith('#!')){fs.writeFileSync(p,'#!/usr/bin/env node\n'+c);fs.chmodSync(p,0o755);}"
